how_its_made:
1 inch Fusion Mode SDK:  We challenged a lot to integrate 1 Inch Fusion mode as the documentation on the website was not up to date and the github repos provided to be helpful but some of the APIs could not be found in the repos and documentation as well. Very good assistance was provided to us on the booth and discord server ranging from SDK integration and API collection to sharing the 1inch tokens on Mainnet for testing and deploying purposes. 
Specially the biggest issue we ran into was the testing part of the Fusion SDSK on the Mainnet as there is no Testnet available for testing and dpeloyment as we did not have the real ether to transfer any funds to polygon or any less gas consuming chain. 
Airstack Tools and Qrapgql :The necessity of executing specific queries prompted a deep dive into GraphQL and Airstack API Studio AI. The reliance on Airstack documentation proved invaluable.
